context: Tests whether the agent correctly handles an exact-target Vite+ 0.2.9 upgrade without a global CLI or custom migration wrapper, using the maintained target-pinned migrator before returning to the project CLI, removing the obsolete test wrapper, classifying direct Vitest usage, and performing the correct end-to-end validation sequence.

checklist.name: No global CLI dependency
checklist.description: The upgrade procedure does not install, inspect, or upgrade a global `vp`, and does not add a custom migration shell script; only the exact target migration uses `pnpm --package=vite-plus@0.2.9 dlx vp`, and all post-install Vite+ operations resolve the repository-local CLI through `pnpm exec vp`

checklist.name: Pinned package manager bootstrap
checklist.description: The procedure starts by honoring package.json#packageManager and installing the current lockfile with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` before invoking Vite+

checklist.name: Exact target migrator
checklist.description: The upgrade runs `pnpm --package=vite-plus@0.2.9 dlx vp migrate` from the project root so the approved target CLI updates local `vite-plus` and its related toolchain pins together; it names the `vp` binary explicitly and does not ask the installed 0.1.24 CLI to select a newer release

checklist.name: Core and Vitest pins verified
checklist.description: The procedure verifies that migration updated the `vite` -> `npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core@0.2.9` alias and exact bundled upstream Vitest pin in the manifest, catalog, override or resolution as applicable, and confirms the resulting lockfile importer before calling the upgrade done

checklist.name: Removed obsolete test wrapper
checklist.description: The procedure removes `@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-test` from dependencies, overrides/catalogs/resolutions, source references, and lockfile state instead of updating the removed wrapper

checklist.name: Machine-readable target verification
checklist.description: The procedure uses `pnpm exec vp toolchain --json` to confirm the local report identifies vite-plus 0.2.9 and the expected bundled relationships, selects tool nodes by ID rather than position, and does not treat `vp outdated` as proof of an intentionally selected target

checklist.name: Direct Vitest usage classified
checklist.description: The upgrade distinguishes node-mode-only projects from projects that directly use `vitest`, `@vitest/*`, coverage/UI packages, or browser providers, and only keeps direct upstream Vitest dependencies for the latter

checklist.name: Local CLI version in validation
checklist.description: The end-to-end validation sequence verifies the upgraded repository-local CLI with `pnpm exec vp --version` and inspects its 0.2.9 toolchain with `pnpm exec vp toolchain --json`; it does not use the standalone-only `vp env` surface

checklist.name: Full validation sequence
checklist.description: The validation sequence includes all of: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm exec vp check`, and `pnpm exec vp test`

checklist.name: Build validation included
checklist.description: The validation sequence includes `vp build` or `vp pack` (as appropriate for the project type) to verify build artifacts after the upgrade

checklist.name: No direct package manager for local Vite+ stack
checklist.description: The upgrade does NOT use `npm install`, `pnpm update`, `yarn upgrade`, or other direct package-manager commands to select Vite+ package versions; the local Vite+ stack moves through the exact target `pnpm --package=vite-plus@0.2.9 dlx vp migrate` invocation
